testCases.title: Test Basic Movement with Doubles
testCases.objective: Test basic checker movement, specifically using all four moves from a double roll (4,4) on the first turn.
testCases.boardSetup: Initial board with White to move.
testCases.process: Sets up a game with dice 4,4. Moves two checkers from White's head (pt 24 / idx 23) to point 20 (idx 19), then moves those same two checkers from point 20 (idx 19) to point 16 (idx 15), using all four available '4' moves.
testCases.expectations: Two checkers move from head (23) to 19, then to 15. Final board state: 13 checkers on head (idx 23), 0 on point 19 (idx 18), 2 on point 15 (idx 14).
testCases.rulesInvolved: Basic movement rules, doubles play (use all four dice values).

testCases.title: Initial Dice Validation
testCases.objective: Verify that chance outcomes produce valid dice pairs.
testCases.process: Checks all chance outcomes to ensure dice values are in [1..6] with highest die first (unless doubles).
testCases.expectations: All dice pairs are valid according to Long Narde rules (1-6, non-equal highest first).

testCases.title: Initial Distribution & First Turn Doubles Move
testCases.objective: Confirm the default setup and a first-turn double move from the head.
testCases.process: Checks initial distribution (15 checkers on each head) and applies a 6,6 roll to move two checkers from White's head.
testCases.expectations: Initial distribution is correct (White@24, Black@12) and two checkers move from White's head as expected on a first-turn 6,6 roll.
testCases.rulesInvolved: Initial setup, special doubles on first turn.

testCases.title: Head Rule (First Turn - White)
testCases.objective: Verify that on the first turn, if White rolls doubles (e.g., 4,4), they are allowed to move two checkers from their head.
testCases.boardSetup: Initial board with White to move.
testCases.process: Sets up an initial game state, applies dice 4,4. Checks legal actions to ensure at least one action moves two checkers off the head.
testCases.expectations: The player should have legal moves that involve moving two checkers from the head point (index 23).
testCases.rulesInvolved: Head rule (first turn exception), special doubles.

testCases.title: Head Rule (Non-First Turn - White)
testCases.objective: Verify that on a non-first turn, even with doubles (e.g., 4,4,4,4), White can only move one checker from their head.
testCases.boardSetup: White: 14 checkers on head (idx 23), 1 checker on point 23 (idx 22). Black: 15 checkers on head (idx 11). White to move.
testCases.process: Sets up a board state where White has one checker off the head. Applies dice 4,4,4,4. Checks legal actions to ensure no action moves more than one checker off the head.
testCases.expectations: No legal action should allow moving more than one checker from the head point (index 23). Subsequent moves must use the checker already off the head (at index 22).

testCases.title: Movement Direction Validation
testCases.objective: Verify that both White and Black move counter-clockwise (towards decreasing indices), with Black wrapping around 0.
testCases.process: Sets up the board and applies dice {3, 2} first for White, then resets and applies for Black. Checks resulting positions against CCW movement rules.
testCases.expectations: Both players move CCW (decreasing indices). White moves 18->15(d3) and 18->16(d2) are valid. Black moves 7->4(d3) and 7->5(d2) are valid.
testCases.rulesInvolved: Movement direction rules (CCW for both, Black wrap-around).
testCases.notes: Visualization shows the state before White's turn.

testCases.title: Cannot Land on Opponent's Point (White)
testCases.objective: Ensure that White cannot land on a point occupied by any number of opposing checkers.
testCases.process: Sets up a board position where a potential White move (pt20 -> pt16 with die 4) would land on Black's point. Checks if the move is invalid via `IsValidCheckerMove` and not present in `LegalActions()`.

testCases.title: Cannot Land on Opponent's Point (Black)
testCases.objective: Ensure that Black cannot land on a point occupied by any number of opposing checkers.
testCases.process: Sets up a board position where a potential Black move (pt16 -> pt13 with die 3) would land on White's point. Checks if the move is invalid via `IsValidCheckerMove` and not present in `LegalActions()`.

testCases.title: Illegal Landings Not in LegalActions (Black)
testCases.objective: Verify that `LegalActions` does not generate moves landing on occupied points for Black, based on a specific failure case.
testCases.process: Sets up a specific board state. Generates legal actions for Black and checks if any action involves landing on White's checker at pt13 (index 12) by moving from pt14 (index 13) with a die of 1.
testCases.expectations: No generated legal action for Black involves moving from index 13 to land on index 12.

testCases.title: Half-Move Generation (White)
testCases.objective: Verify that `GenerateAllHalfMoves` produces the correct set of potential single-die moves for White.
testCases.process: Generates all half-moves for White and compares against the expected set.
testCases.expectations: Expected half-moves: {pos=23, die=3}, {pos=23, die=5}. The checker at pos 0 has no valid moves. The generated `LegalActions` should be constructible from these half-moves.

testCases.title: Head Rule (Black - First Turn Special Doubles)
testCases.objective: Test that on Black's first turn, special doubles (e.g., 6,6) allow moving two checkers from the head.
testCases.boardSetup: Initial board after White's first move, Black to move.
testCases.process: Sets up a game state for Black's first turn, applies dice 6,6. Checks if legal actions permit moving two checkers off the head (point 12 / index 11).
testCases.expectations: Black should have legal moves allowing two checkers to move from the head (index 11). For example, moving two checkers 11 -> 5.
testCases.rulesInvolved: Head rule for Black (first turn exception), special doubles.
testCases.notes: Corresponds to Scenario A in the C++ code.

testCases.title: Head Rule (Black - Non-First Turn Doubles)
testCases.objective: Test that on a non-first turn, even with doubles (e.g., 4,4,4,4), Black can only move one checker from the head.
testCases.boardSetup: Black has 14 checkers on head (idx 11), 1 checker on point 16 (idx 15). White has 15 checkers on head (idx 23). Black to move.
testCases.process: Sets up a board state where Black has one checker off the head. Applies dice 4,4,4,4. Checks legal actions to ensure no action moves more than one checker off the head (index 11).
testCases.expectations: According to the head rule for non-first turns, only one checker can leave the head (index 11) during the entire turn, even with doubles. The first move must be 11 -> 7 (using one '4'). The checker initially at index 15 is within Black's home board (indices 17-12) and cannot move with a '4'; bearing off is not possible, and the target destination (index 11) is outside the valid forward movement path for a checker within the home board. The checker now at index 7 (having moved from 11) can then move 7 -> 3 (using a second '4'). No further moves are possible with the remaining two '4's: the checker at 15 still has no valid move with a '4', and the checker now at 3 cannot move with a '4' as the destination (index 23) is blocked by the opponent's head. Thus, the only valid full action for this turn consists of the sequence (11->7, 7->3), utilizing only two of the four available dice; the remaining two dice must be passed.
testCases.rulesInvolved: Head rule for Black (standard), doubles play.
testCases.notes: Corresponds to Scenario B in the C++ code.

testCases.title: Half-Move Generation (Black)
testCases.objective: Verify that `GenerateAllHalfMoves` produces the correct set of potential single-die moves for Black.
testCases.process: Generates all half-moves for Black and compares against the expected set.
testCases.expectations: Expected half-moves: {pos=11, die=4}, {pos=11, die=2}, {pos=16, die=4}, {pos=16, die=2}. All generated `LegalActions` should be constructible from these.
